# Glasp

Glasp helps users save bookmarks, capture and organize highlights, import Kindle highlights, and access AI-generated summaries.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/glasp/.

## Actions

- **Create Highlights**: Create between 1 and 100 highlights in the connected Glasp account in one request.
- **Delete Highlights**: Delete one Glasp highlight, or explicitly delete all highlights associated with one source document.
- **Get Summary** (read-only): Fetch one Glasp summary by ID, optionally including the stored page or PDF Markdown content when available.
- **List Bookmarks** (read-only): Return one page of pages the connected user saved to Glasp without highlighting, optionally limited to bookmarks updated after a timestamp.
- **List Highlights** (read-only): Return one page of the connected user's non-Kindle Glasp documents and their nested highlights, optionally limited to records updated…
- **List Kindle Highlights** (read-only): Return one page of the connected user's read-only Kindle books and highlights imported into Glasp, optionally limited to records updated…
- **List Summaries** (read-only): Return one page of AI summaries generated by the connected user for pages, PDFs, and YouTube videos, optionally limited to records updated…
- **Save Bookmark**: Save a URL as a Glasp bookmark, or update the existing bookmark when that URL is already saved.
- **Update Highlight**: Update editable fields on one Glasp highlight identified by its source URL and highlight ID.
